children: New York, October 06, 2026-- Moody's Ratings assigned a Baa2 rating to United States Steel Corporation's new tax-exempt backed senior unsecured environmental revenue bonds to be issued by Indiana Finance Authority, and unconditionally guaranteed by NIPPON STEEL CORPORATION. The proceeds from the offering will be loaned by IFA to U. S. Steel to refinance U. S. Steel's existing IFA 2021 A tax-exempt revenue bonds maturing in December 2026.

title: Moody's Ratings assigns Baa2 rating to U. S. Steel's new IFA tax-exempt bonds guaranteed by NSC
